title.narrative: Främja Georgiens gröna och inkluderande utveckling - ISET PI
Promoting Georgia's Green and Inclusive Development - ISET PI

description.narrative: Det strategiska målet för kärnstödet är att främja Georgiens gröna och inkluderande utveckling genom att stödja evidensbaserat beslutsfattande och kapacitetsuppbyggnad hos politiska parter.
Strategic Objective of the core support grant is Promoting Georgia’s Green and Inclusive Development Through Supporting Evidence-Based Policy Making and Capacity Building of Policy Parties.

There are five objectives for achieving the stated overarching strategic objective: 1) Maximizing ISET-PIs contribution and impact on evidence-based policy making, including green and inclusive growth, and the EU; 2) Developing the capacity of key policy parties the national government, parliament, and local government for the design and implementation of policies, and civil society and businesses for effective participation in policy formulation and debate, with a focus on the green and inclusive growth agenda and EU harmonization; 3) Contributing to public outreach and dialogue on the green and inclusive growth agenda and other priority areas; 4) Broadening and deepening regional cooperation on global and regional challenges in the Eastern Partnership and beyond. 5) Building the institutional resilience and sustainability of ISET-PI as a prime economic think tank through effectively managing institutional risks.

sector.narrative: Public sector policy and administrative management

description.narrative: ISET PI for the year 2023-2024 increased its relevance and visibility. Despite the challenging political environment, ISET Policy Institute (ISETPI) maintained its position as a leading economic think tank in Georgia. Its policy impact across economic issues remained substantial, and the institute continued to produce high quality outputs (economic indexes, policy papers, research reports) and activities (regulatory impact assessments, gender analysis, public outreach).
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
